title: Column Addition pt
code:
ALTER TABLE Students
      ADD COLUMN firstYear INTEGER;

lines.explanation: Clausula ALTER TABLE para incluir a coluna 'firstYear' 'a tabela ja existente 'Students'.

The most common use of the ALTER TABLE statement. The column definition clause in the ALTER TABLE statement is just like the one in the CREATE TABLE statement and it works the same way.
Esse e' o uso mais comum da clausula ALTER TABLE. A definicao da coluna (nome e tipo de dado) acontece da mesma forma que na clausula CREATE TABLE.
